reauth_confirm.title: Renew portal session
reauth_confirm.description: The portal no longer accepts the stored token (for example after signing out). Sign in to the portal again and hand over the new session.

user.title: Burgenland Energie customer portal
user.description: The portal login is captcha-protected, so you sign in yourself and Home Assistant takes over that session. How do you want to hand over the session?

handover.title: Hand over the portal session
handover.description:
If no tab opened (pop-up blocked): **Ctrl+click** (Mac: Cmd+click) **[the handover page]({url})** to open it in a new tab. A plain click is caught by Home Assistant and closes this dialog.

On that page, drag the bookmark to your bookmarks bar, sign in at meine.burgenlandenergie.at and click the bookmark there. **Keep this dialog open** — it continues automatically. The link works once and for 15 minutes.

paste.title: Paste the token
paste.description:
The portal login is protected by a captcha, so Home Assistant takes over an existing portal session via its refresh token.

1. Sign in at meine.burgenlandenergie.at and tick **Angemeldet bleiben** (stay signed in).
2. Create a bookmark with this address and click it on the portal page - the token is copied to the clipboard:

`{bookmarklet}`

   Alternatively: developer tools (F12) → Console → `copy(localStorage.getItem('okc-auth-refreshToken'))`
3. Paste the token here.

Do not sign out of the portal afterwards, or the token becomes invalid.

data_description.refresh_token: Long text from the portal (about 1,900 characters). Stored only in Home Assistant.

error.invalid_token: This does not look like a refresh token. Paste the complete text without spaces.
error.invalid_auth: The portal rejected the token. Sign in again and copy the current token.
error.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different customer account.

abort.already_configured: This customer account is already configured.

data.meter_days: Days of usage data per run

data_description.save_invoices: New invoices are stored in the media folder under burgenland_energie.
data_description.meter_days: This many days up to yesterday are re-read on every run (late corrections).

download_invoice.name: Download invoice
download_invoice.description: Saves an invoice as PDF in the media folder (burgenland_energie).

bill_nr.name: Invoice number
bill_nr.description: Leave empty for the latest invoice.

all_missing.name: All missing invoices
all_missing.description: Save every invoice that is not stored as a verified PDF yet (ignores the invoice number).

import_meter_data.name: Import usage data
import_meter_data.description: Re-reads the billed daily values of all meters.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days up to yesterday, e.g. 1000 for the full history.

import_fanclub_invoices.name: Import energy community invoices
import_fanclub_invoices.description: Saves the invoice PDFs from Fanclub Burgenland Energieunabhängig e-mails (fetched through the IMAP integration) next to the other invoices and reads their amounts. Mails from other senders are ignored.

imap_entry.name: IMAP entry
imap_entry.description: The IMAP integration entry whose folder holds the Fanclub mails.

uid.name: Mail UIDs
uid.description: UID of the mail (from the imap_content event), or a list/range such as '1-9' or '3,5'.
